requirements.verifier_assertion: Running the program twice on the same input must produce byte-identical output — test.sh reruns solution.py and asserts cmp -s /app/result.json /tmp/result_rerun.json (test.sh:191, test.sh:193)

The program lives at /app/solution.py and is invoked as `python solution.py --input /app/inputs --output /app/result.json` — verifier reruns exactly this shape for the determinism check (test.sh:188, test.sh:191)

The move alphabet is defined by the six faces (U/D/L/R/F/B) crossed with three modifiers (bare=90 CW quarter turn, '=90 CCW quarter turn, 2=180 half turn), yielding the 18 tokens listed in notation.json — verifier reads notation.json's tokens list as the alphabet enforcement (test.sh: alphabet=set(notation['tokens']))
must_include: U, D, L, R, F, B
